title: Add Chat language and context controls
goal: Give users persistent controls for Chat response language and the number of recent conversation turns included in the model context.
context: Chat already builds contextual input from recent conversation turns and relevant memory, but the context length has no user-facing control and the assistant language preference cannot be selected from Chat.
forbidden_changes: Do not change provider routing, model loading, or tool execution.
Do not weaken privacy controls or remove relevant memory from contextual input.
Do not modify PersonalAgent.xcodeproj or unrelated modules.
acceptance_criteria: Users can select automatic, Vietnamese, or English response language from Chat.
The selected language preference is persisted and included in contextual input unless the user explicitly requests another language.
Users can select 4, 8, 12, 24, or 48 recent turns for context.
Context length selection is persisted and the active conversation builder uses the selected limit.
verification: Review final PR checks and changed-file scope
recovery: Revert the single task commit if build or interaction review fails; preserve existing conversation history and privacy behavior.
